reviews.comment:
“Inempeorable” creo que resume la experiencia en esta estación. Desgano, mala voluntad, altanerismo, incompetencia, impunidad son solo algunos de los apelativos que le doy. Colas larguísimas a cualquier hora (tuve la desgracia de tener que cargar ahí dos veces durante mis vacaciones) y no tengas la mala suerte de que llegue el camión de YPF porque en ese momento cierran la estación por completo (ambas islas) y sin ninguna necesidad pero claro es mejor cerrar y tomar mate por más de una hora que hacer el esfuerzo de atender por un lado esquivando al camión. Carguen en Aimogasta si aman YPF y sino a dos cuadras hay una genérica que no aparece en Google pero que tiene combustible y al menos para no perder una hora de tu vida con esta gentuza se las recomiendo.

(Translated by Google)
"Unbeatable" is probably the best way to sum up my experience at this station. Lack of enthusiasm, ill will, arrogance, incompetence, and impunity are just a few of the words I'd use to describe it. Extremely long lines at any time of day (I had the misfortune of having to fill up there twice during my vacation), and don't be unlucky enough to have the YPF truck arrive because at that moment they close the entire station (both pumps), completely unnecessarily. Of course, it's better to close and drink mate for over an hour than to make the effort to serve customers while dodging the truck. Fill up in Aimogasta if you love YPF, and if not, there's a generic station two blocks away that doesn't appear on Google but actually has fuel. At least to avoid wasting an hour of your life with these crooks, I recommend it.

(Translated by Google)
Endless waits, they don't invest, because they have no competition. It's unbelievable that Tinogasta, with such a huge city, has such a disastrous YPF gas station. The main complaint is about the infrastructure; you can't expect more from the beachgoers who also have to endure terrible temperatures.
